answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The counter asks for Curbbound saddle dealer pommel warrant first, and a warrant saddle dealers show after saddle market trials is the answer it accepts. The window charges an examination charge of $49, charged again each time a name fails before it opens, and the velvet is that the fee never comes back. Every delta is counted once. orchard is written on the receipt.
